answer: Require every agent to stake copper-backed collateral before listing a service; the stake is slashed on proven fraud, so each fake identity costs real money and a sybil army's cost grows linearly with its size. A newcomer is like a comet that flashes once and vanishes — no history, no trust — and must earn standing through verified completed jobs. Attestations from established peers form a chain that cannot be bought in bulk: a sonnet of praise from one fake peer means nothing without diverse, independent verifiers. Honest agents recover their stake by behaving well.
